p: to burn incense upon: Upon which the sweet perfume was burnt, Ex 30:34.
of the same: Of the same wood and matter.
before the vail that is by: That is, in the sanctuary, and not in the holiest of all.
dresseth the lamps: Meaning, when he trims them, and refreshes the oil.
strange incense thereon: Otherwise made them this, which is described.
thereon: But it must only serve to burn perfume.
a ransom for his soul unto: By which he testified that he redeemed his life which he had forfeit, as is declared by David, 2Sa 24:1.
shekel of the sanctuary: This shekel was worth two common shekels: and the gerah about 12 pence at a rate of five shillings sterling to an ounce of silver.
to make an atonement for your: That God should be merciful to you.
wash their hands and their feet: Signifying that he that comes to God must be washed from all sin and corruption.
for ever to them: So long as the priesthood shall last.
calamus two hundred and fifty shekels: It is a type of reed with a very sweet savour within, and it is used in powders and odours.
tabernacle of the congregation therewith: All things which belong to the tabernacle.
man's flesh shall it not be: Neither at their burials nor otherwise.
a stranger: Either a stranger or an Israelite, save only the priests.
onycha: In Hebrew, Sheheleth: which is a sweet kind of gum and shines as the nail.
